INDICATION:  ___ year old male w/ bilateral staghorn calculi// PCN placement

time of 1 hour 40 minutes during which the patient's hemodynamic parameters
were continuously monitored by an independent trained radiology nurse.  1%
lidocaine was injected in the skin and subcutaneous tissues overlying the
access site.
MEDICATIONS: 1 g ceftriaxone
CONTRAST: 30 ml of Optiray contrast
FLUOROSCOPY TIME AND DOSE:  10 minutes 48 seconds, 56 mGy


PROCEDURE:  1. Right ultrasound guided renal collecting system access.
